# C++ Core Guidelines — every rule

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_core_guidelines.py from modules/CppCoreGuidelines (commit 5baf9fe, Jun 14, 2026 edition); don't edit by hand. -->

Every section and every rule of the official [C++ Core Guidelines](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines) (Stroustrup, Sutter), Jun 14, 2026 edition, upstream commit [`5baf9fe`](https://github.com/isocpp/CppCoreGuidelines/commit/5baf9fe252d034e8363217efc6e12c2215f2a442): **529 entries**, nothing left out. Each page lists its section's rules with their official IDs and titles and links to the official text.

The rule text itself isn't copied here: the Guidelines' licence permits copies for personal or internal business use only. Read a rule at its link, or in the submodule (`git submodule update --init`, then search `modules/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines.md` for the rule ID).

Worked examples for some rules are in [core-guidelines.md](../core-guidelines.md); more are welcome. Regenerate this index with `python3 tools/gen_core_guidelines.py` after moving the submodule.

## Examples and tests

Our own examples are in [`examples/`](examples/), one page per section, and the unit tests that check them in [`tests/guidelines/`](../../../tests/guidelines/) (#235). Each section page links them, rule by rule, where they exist.
